lead: Renaming a module-doc section leaves every citation of it pointing at a heading that no longer exists, and nothing `nv verify` runs reads a `§ *Title*` reference.
body: Splitting `route.rs`'s and `serve.rs`'s headings stranded `crates/nvs-server/src/lib.rs:88`, and moving a gap block moved the `file.rs:NN-NN` spans that `docs/agent/goals/m7-server-surface.md:67` quotes for it. Grep the old title *and* the old line span across `crates/` and `docs/agent/goals/` in the same call that makes the edit.
